item.title: Tor Stealth Tunnel: Anonymous Data Interception
item.description:
Project Overview The Tor Stealth Tunnel is a secure, store-and-forward reverse proxy infrastructure designed to receive public web traffic while completely obfuscating the physical location and IP address of the destination server. This proof-of-concept demonstrates advanced network privacy techniques by decoupling the public-facing entry point from the secure client machine.

Architectural Design The infrastructure is segmented into a three-tier architecture to ensure maximum operational security and mitigate direct denial-of-service (DDoS) vectors:

item.title: Industrial Software & Custom Hardware Architecture
item.description:
Beecortex Engineering Execution Bridging the gap between physical circuit layouts and cross-platform industrial software.

  • Reverse Engineering & Sensing: Designed custom PCB schematics and routed hardware for precision timing systems. Wrote the STM32 Black Pill firmware to handle hardware interrupts for ultrasonic echo detection.
  • Complex Multiplexing: Engineered the custom circuit wiring, NPN transistor layer switching, and low-level ATmega328P C++ multiplexing logic for 3x3x3 and 4x4x4 LED matrix structures.
  • Industrial Software Environments: Developed 2D and 3D Gaussian Process Regression models in FastAPI and Streamlit to drive real-time false-color tank thickness visualization dashboards for industrial corrosion mapping.
